description: This file defines a React-like component called 'Home' that assembles the main page layout for an ocean-themed notes application. It includes references to other components such as NotesList and EditorPane, manages state for selected notes, and wiring for event handling such as selection, creation, update, and deletion of notes. It also defines key bindings for creating new notes and focusing different parts of the UI.

classes.name: Home
classes.description: Main page component for displaying header, notes list, and editor pane, with event wiring for note operations.

methods.name: mounted
methods.description: Lifecycle hook that sets up event listeners for note selection, creation, update, and deletion, ensuring the UI stays synchronized with data changes.

methods.name: key
methods.description: Input handler that responds to specific key presses ('n', 'f', 'e') to create new notes, focus list for filtering, or focus editor content.
